transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. I guess the main thing bringing me in is that I just keep getting pulled off track by every little sound or thought. Like, I’ll be trying to work on a job application, and then... a car goes by outside, or my phone lights up, or some random idea just pops into my head. And before I even notice what happened, it sends me somewhere else and I'm off doing something completely different. It's making it really hard to get anything done.
Do these distractions and difficulties staying focused happen in other situations too, like when you're reading, talking to someone, or trying to listen during a conversation?

Yeah, it definitely happens in other situations. Like, if I'm trying to figure out how to fix something and I start watching a repair video or reading the manual for a tool... after just a few minutes, I'll realize I've just been staring at it. I end up having to rewind the video or re-read the page because none of the information actually stuck in my head. I just zone out.
Have you had trouble staying focused or being easily distracted like this since you were a child, or is this something that started more recently?

It's been going on since I was a kid. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers were always having to move my seat around. I would talk out of turn a lot, or I'd forget my homework... and whenever we had worksheets, I would just rush through them and make a bunch of careless mistakes. So, yeah, it's definitely not a new thing.
Do you often feel restless, have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting on impulse without thinking it through?

Yeah, I do. Um... since I can’t really play soccer like I used to before, just sitting around the house gets really hard. It honestly makes me feel like I’m crawling out of my skin. I just can't stay still, so I usually end up just pacing from room to room.
Do you often find yourself acting quickly without thinking things through, like interrupting others, making sudden decisions, or feeling like you just can't wait?

Yeah, I definitely do that. I cut people off a lot. Like, especially my mom or the counselor I see. It's just... an answer pops into my head while they're talking, and I just say it before they're even done. I don't really mean to, it just sort of comes out.
Do these issues with staying focused, feeling restless, and acting without thinking happen in different places or situations, like at home, work, or when you're out with friends?

Yeah, it's pretty much everywhere. Um, at home with my mom, like I said, I can't sit still and I interrupt her all the time. When I'm out with friends, it's the same thing... I get distracted easily or just blurt things out. And when I used to work, it was definitely an issue there too. It's not just one place, it's kind of just how I am all the time.
Have these issues with focus, restlessness, and impulsivity caused you significant problems in your daily life, like in school, work, relationships, or completing everyday tasks?

Yeah, they definitely cause problems. Um, right now I'm trying to become an automotive technician. I know I can handle the hands-on work just fine, but... I've missed a bunch of training deadlines. And I've had to redo my applications so many times because I just can't stay focused enough to get them right the first time. Because of all that, I'm just... I'm still not moving forward with it. It really holds me back from getting anywhere.
Can you describe how you feel emotionally most of the time? Have you noticed feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I get frustrated sometimes because of the whole... you know, missing deadlines and messing up applications thing. But I wouldn't say I feel down or hopeless. I still like doing the stuff I usually enjoy, I just... have a hard time staying on track with the important things. I don't feel depressed, if that's what you mean.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting, tapping your hands or feet, or moving around even when you're trying to stay still? Or maybe you feel like your thoughts are always racing?

Yeah, definitely. Um, I'm always moving something. Like, if I'm sitting down with someone, my leg is usually bouncing up and down. Or I'll be clicking a pen, or just messing around with my keys in my pocket. Half the time, I don't even realize I'm doing it until someone points it out or I catch myself. I just can't really sit completely still.
Looking back, did these symptoms of being easily distracted, restless, and impulsive clearly start before age 12, or did they develop more recently?

Yeah, they definitely started a long time ago. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers were always moving my seat around because I was always talking out of turn. I forgot my homework all the time, too. And whenever we had to do worksheets in class, I would just rush through them and make a bunch of careless mistakes. So, yeah, it's been like this since way before I was 12.
